question: From which year did Sangeet Natak Akademi, New Delhi, institute the Ustad Bismillah Khan Yuva Puraskar?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2006**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ustad Bismillah Khan Yuva Puraskar** is an award given by the **Sangeet Natak Akademi.**
 
• Outstanding young artists under 40 are given it.
 
• **It first began in 2006.**
 
• The following **five fields** of action are **eligible** for the **Yuva Puraskar**:
 
 
• Music
 
• Dance
 
• Theatre
 
• Other Traditional / Folk/ Tribal/ Dance/ Music/ Theatre and Puppetry
 
• Contribution / Scholarship in Performing Arts
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ustad Bismillah Khan Yuva Puraskar**

 
 
• ​The** Sangeet Natak Akademi bestows the Ustad Bismillah Khan Yuva Puraskar**, an annual honour, on excellent artists under the age of 40 who have shown talent in the arts of music, dance, and drama.
 
• The goal of the prize is to provide emerging artists with national prominence at this point in their careers.
 
• Up to **33 performers **are chosen each year.
 
• The **prize money for winners is 25,000 rupees ($310)**. Since 2006, the award has been presented.
